label: columnar cell of endocervix
definition: A columnar epithelial cell that is part of the endocervical mucosa, forming a single layer of mucinous columnar epithelium lining the cervical canal.
reason: Cell types typically belong in the Cell Ontology (CL), not UBERON. UBERON references cell types from CL (e.g., CL:0000075 'columnar/cuboidal epithelial cell') but generally does not define individual cell types directly. The term has been assigned a UBERON ID (UBERON_8930209), suggesting it should be added to UBERON, but this conflicts with standard ontology design patterns.
